description: Tremor score > 0.7 and drip rate > 10 mL/hr within 10s -> tremor prioritized as primary signal.
note: evt-001 is evaluated against the window seen so far (drip only) -> iv_alert. When evt-002 arrives 4.5s later, both signals are now in-window -> ambiguity rule fires and tremor is prioritized. Decisions are never retroactively revised (see README: 'per-event window evaluation').
